mainEntity.name: How much does bathroom countertop installation cost in Denver?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs commonly depend on material, vanity size, edge profile, and the number of cutouts. In Denver, bathroom vanity countertop pricing is often quoted around $400 to $1,800 per vanity, with many single-sink projects landing lower and double-vanity or premium-stone projects landing higher.
